integrity: Analytical argument applies to every finite N; finite computational checks only corroborate the proof. Scholarly priority and independent validation have not been established.
scientific_limitations: Proves at least N distinct strict local mean-first-passage-time minima for each finite N, not N globally minimizing equal-value rates; no upper bound or exhaustive phase diagram.
title: Unbounded multiplicity of local reset-rate optima in a Brownian search
